Container.Name: x3-sync
Container.Overview: Sends new EPUBs from the Calibre library to a CrossPoint-flashed Xteink X3, optimized for its 528x792 screen, whenever the X3 is on the File Transfer screen.

Config.Name: Calibre library
Config.Description: Folder containing metadata.db (the same one CWA uses)

Config.Name: State
Config.Description: Holds state.json (which books were already sent)

Config.Name: X3 IP address
Config.Description: Fixed IP of the X3 (set a DHCP reservation). Leave empty only on br0/host networking.

Config.Name: Settle seconds
Config.Description: Wait this long after a book was last modified before sending it

Config.Name: Seed existing library
Config.Description: On first run, treat books already in the library as sent

Config.Name: Optimize
Config.Description: Optimize EPUBs for the X3 before upload

Config.Name: Split text
Config.Description: Split large paragraphs/chapters and strip fonts (prevents out-of-memory)

Config.Name: Path template
Config.Description: Folders/filename on the X3, each / is a folder. Fields: {author} {author_sort} {authors} {title} {id}

Config.Name: Upload folder
Config.Description: Base folder on the X3's SD card

Config.Name: ASCII names
Config.Description: Transliterate folder/file names to plain ASCII

Config.Name: Overwrite existing
Config.Description: If the file is already on the X3: false = skip, true = replace
